title: Helwit Blueberry Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches 15mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Blueberry Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches deliver a richer take on Blueberry, offering a juicy, slightly tart fruit profile with a satisfying punch. The Extra Strong 15mg strength is ideal for experienced pouch users seeking a stronger nicotine release with full flavour to match. Each pouch is slim, discreet, and made from plant-based materials for comfortable daily use. With no smoke, vapour or tobacco, Blueberry Extra Strong is a clean, easy option for those who want a fuss-free format with serious impact. Part of Helwit’s Extra Strong range, this pouch balances fruity flavour with a powerful nicotine kick. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
